newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB pays 635p/shr for Lloyds Abbey.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB pays 635p/shr for Lloyds Abbey.

text.p: Britain's Lloyds TSB Group Plc said on Friday it would pay about 635 pence per share, excluding any tax credit, for the rest of Lloyds Abbey Life Plc.
Under the proposal, LAL minority shareholders will get six Lloyds TSB shares for every seven LAL shares held and 300 pence in cash for every Lloyds Abbey Life share, the bank said in a statement.
On the basis of Thursday's closing price of 592 pence, the deal values each Lloyds Abbey Life share at 635 pence, it added.

"Both parties believe that the proposal would be in the best interests of customers, staff and shareholders," Lloyds TSB said in a brief statement, as LAL's shares jumped to a new year high of 630 pence each.
LAL stock was trading at 623.5 pence, a rise of 31.5 pence, by 0938 GMT. Lloyds TSB's shares slipped 4.5 pence to 386.5p.
The bank said it expected to publish full details of the proposal early next week.

Shares in life insurer Lloyds Abbey Life have been surging in anticipation of Lloyds TSB, which already held a controlling 62.6 percent stake, buying the outstanding 37.4 percent. British newspapers had reported on Friday that Lloyds was ready to put up 700p in cash and shares for the outstanding stake.
